classes.description: two fields, at least one from a risky subclass
byline gains given names, accents, suffixes or missing co-authors from the source; no citation detail lost
existing two-source generators (Crossref + PubMed, or JATS + PubMed) now unblocked
same first page; end page added or corrected, or pages added
pre-1975 'JEP: General' -> 'Journal of Experimental Psychology', or a <=3-letter venue typo
title word fix from Crossref alone (<=2 word edits or missing subtitle)
pages = article number, spurious number dropped (JATS + PubMed agree; rule A1b)
volume, issue, different first page, or print year taken from the source
title word fix where PubMed has the same title as Crossref
a surname spelling changes to the source's (<=2 letters); registry typos are possible
a different venue name (identity pinned by exact title, first author, year, volume and first page)
